articles.title: Manga 'Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu' Gets TV Anime in Spring 2027
articles.description: Production company TOHO animation opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Toshiya Wakabayashi's Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu (Happy Kanako's Killer Life) manga on Saturday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime series will premiere in April 2027. Cast Kanako Nishino: Hana Tamegai (The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: U149) Sakurai: Ryouta Suzuki (Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai) Shachou: Junichi Suwab...

articles.title: 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Reveals Main Cast, Teaser Promo
articles.description: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nanai Umihoshi's Kizuguchi to Houtai (Wound and Bandage) manga revealed the main cast, a theme visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere on January 9, 2027 at 11:00 p.m. on AT-X, followed by ABC TV and TV Asahi on the ANiMAZiNG programming block.
